facts.fact: Semafor reports the 2022 Nigeria Startup Act is law, with NITDA's director general saying the government is committed to invest in startups under it.
Semafor reports about 13,000 businesses registered as startups using NITDA's criteria, which gives a three-year income tax exemption and investor tax credits.

note: The $40M fund was only to be signed the following month, so no funded fact.
